text:
maria gonzalez: Quick design review — I'm iterating on the forms validation patterns for the Console. Two small nudges: how we show required fields (asterisk vs explicit hint) and when we surface inline errors (on blur vs on submit). Screenshot: https://redwood-assets/internal/forms/required-hint.png

eli choi: Asterisk + visible 'Required' on hover works for compact layouts. We should also expose aria-required on the input for ATs.

sofia liu: Asterisk alone isn't enough for screen readers — please add a visually hidden '(required)' text in the label or use aria-label to include it. For long forms I prefer explicit hint text under the field.

jamal parker: Related: realtime validation vs on-submit. Realtime (typing) errors can be noisy. Proposal: validate on blur and show a summary after submit if there are multiple issues.

maria gonzalez: My thinking: inline error after blur, persistent error message until corrected; aggregate summary at top on submit. For required fields show a short hint 'Required' when focused, otherwise keep UI minimal.

eli choi: Agree on blur. For destructive actions (delete dataset) do we require typed confirm (enter name) or a single confirm with checkbox? Typed confirm prevents accidental deletes but is heavier.

sofia liu: Typed confirm for irreversible actions (delete with no undo) is recommended. Modal copy should say exactly what will be deleted, and include the dataset name. Make the confirm input accessible: label, placeholder, and aria-describedby pointing to the explanatory copy. Ensure focus trap and visible focus styles.

jamal parker: @sofia can we reuse the existing 'delete-app' modal component? If so we can standardize behavior across Console and speed rollout.

maria gonzalez: Quick lightweight experiment idea: two variants for the required-field pattern — A) compact asterisk with visually hidden '(required)' for screen readers + focus hint, B) explicit secondary label 'Required' under the field. Run a 5-person unmoderated test + quick internal poll.

eli choi: :thumbsup: for A (compact, scales better).

sofia liu: :thumbsdown: prefer B (clearer in complex forms, fewer a11y assumptions).

jamal parker: I'll spin up the internal test and collect qualitative notes from SRE, Support, and Growth.

design-bot: Poll created (A vs B) — closes 2026-04-02. Results will be summarized in this thread.

maria gonzalez: I'll draft the component PR with both variants and include ARIA examples and microcopy options (e.g., 'Required', 'This field is required for saving'). Posting draft by EOD.

eli choi: Tiny copy nit for the delete modal: prefer 'Permanently delete' over just 'Delete' for clarity.

sofia liu: +1 to 'Permanently delete' and include reminder of backups/retention if applicable.

maria gonzalez: Thanks — I'll include that in the copybank and attach a11y checklist. Follow-ups: jamal will run tests, I'll open PR, eli + sofia to review copy.

jamal parker: noted, putting a calendar invite for quick sync tomorrow.

maria gonzalez: (postscript) If anyone has edge-case forms (multi-step or dynamic lists) DM me examples so I can cover them in the PR.
